name: thimble-lean
description: thimble's lean kernel and shell: the `lean` command reads and queries any files, keeps the code, inputs and source rows behind every value, and saves objects as program + data + lineage; each object Claude saves is drawn under its reply with the verbs that fit it, opens in a detail view that keeps the chat going, and opens in the browser and back. Verbs are folders in verbs/.
